variants.prompt:
Create a realistic production-quality Chinese PUBLIC WEBSITE UI design for 视界 AIMaster, modern technology corporate website, not a dashboard or poster. Target dimensions 1440px wide × 1700px high scrollable desktop website. Current date 2026-10-07. One coherent full page, no browser chrome, no device, no numbered options or collage. Use the attached approved homepage for visual identity, white ground, navy headings #111C3D, blue #0866FF, pale blue accents, tasteful photography, generous clean spacing and professional Chinese type, body14–16px equivalent. The attached old scene page provides brand and content grounding; REMOVE its sidebar, search/filter toolbar, giant selected scene, separate detail preview and algorithm section.

THE USER'S CORRECTION IS THE HARD DESIGN CONSTRAINT: categories are laid out ACROSS THE TOP, and scene CONTENT IS ALREADY LAID OUT BELOW on the SAME PAGE. One category is selected by default. Category selection updates the content IN PLACE; it never navigates to a separate industry landing page. Do NOT design an industry-only gateway, four grouped industry entry menus, popup chooser, or empty state awaiting a click. Do NOT reuse the rejected multi-page industry gateway. This full mock MUST show horizontal categories at top AND six actual city-scene items below. Default selected category 城市治理, visibly active blue. There is no 全部 default.

The small viewing-dimension choice above the categories is 行业场景 (active) and 能力分类 (secondary). This is low-emphasis, not two giant app tabs. Only ONE category set appears at any time: this frame shows 16 industries, not the 13 ability classes as well. Switching to 能力分类 would replace the category row with 13 categories and the results, still in this same page. Do not show additional capability dropdowns, status filters, sidebars, type pills, advanced filters, analytics, source IDs, planning counts or large search fields. The point is immediate browsing and one clear selection.

Global header EXACT: 视界 AIMaster, 产品能力 / 应用场景(active underline) / 部署与集成 / 资源与支持, blue 预约演示 on far right. Appointment navigates to separate /demo page, never modal/inline form, and future form only contains 公司名称 and 联系方式. Compact introductory banner approx180–220px high with 应用场景 and subtext 按行业或识别对象浏览场景，了解具体用途与使用条件。 Optional faint realistic lakeside-city panorama cropped on right. No huge city hero that hides categories; scene imagery is the main visual content.

Lay out the EXACT16 industries in TWO HORIZONTAL ROWS, eight per row, readable flat text labels with enough space:
row1 城市治理 / 交通运输 / 公安与园区安防 / 应急与消防 / 住建与施工 / 水利与河湖 / 港航与渔政 / 生态环境
row2 电网运维 / 新能源运维 / 油气与石化 / 自然资源 / 林草保护 / 农业与畜牧 / 矿山管理 / 景区与校园.
Only 城市治理 is active, others neutral navy/gray. No category thumbnail/photo/icon for each name. Use a thin separating line below classification area. Categories stay visually separate from body items without boxed app containers.

Below category area, small heading 城市治理 and context 垃圾杂物、占道经营、市容设施与城市环境巡查。 Then SIX equal-priority scene items, ALL with image, name, a short understandable statement and subtle 查看详情 →. Content should be browsable on this page immediately. Do not select one giant hero scene or mix it with unrelated mini rows. The items are based on actual imported planning catalog; status is not inferred. Exact names and source-grounded display copy:
垃圾杂物识别 — 发现可见垃圾与杂物，记录位置供现场复核。
摊贩及店外经营识别 — 结合通行区域与管理规则，发现经营占用线索。
井盖雨水箅缺损识别 — 检查缺失、破损或明显移位，保留相关画面。
横幅及悬挂物识别 — 发现横幅及悬挂物，记录位置供设置管理核查。
车辆占用通道与车牌识别 — 当前城市应用：记录消防登高面及消防通道占用线索。 (do not imply city-context plate extraction)
绿化植被区域分割 — 提取绿化带等植被范围，记录可见边界。
Actual internal codes401/404/308/410/216/902 need NOT be visible. City-specific descriptions apply, not all cross-industry variants.

Photography: genuinely plausible observational photos with perspective and scale, city roadside litter, storefront stalls, a road drain/manhole with visible damage, street banner, a parked vehicle obstructing a marked fire-service access corridor, a city vegetation strip. Consistent natural materials, no surreal cities or holographic effects. Photos are illustrative and don't prove actual detection. Tiny photo corner label 场景示意 is sufficient. NO fake confidence percentage, electric hazard claim, extraction of readable plate, customer names, incidents, live tracking, identifiable face, fake legal enforcement. Badged supported/training status is not assigned to any item because the source status is unmaintained. Public availability fields remain for real later maintenance, not extra filters here.

All items link to corresponding scene detail, where input/conditions/flight guidance and AIMasterflow algorithm chain are explained. Algorithm chain remains prominent on approved homepage and in scene detail; do NOT add a repeated large pipeline or benefits module at bottom of this catalog. Use ONE understated 加载更多场景 button after the six shown items (same-category items append on page). No fake page numbers, no 跳转行业页, no industry-entry cards.

Near footer minimal conversion line 了解场景适配与部署方式 with 预约演示 →, then understated ordinary footer. Quiet note 场景画面为示意，实际支持状态以具体介绍为准. Avoid card walls: no borders/shadows around each scene; keep one continuous page with whitespace or flat dividers. No heavy app table, repeating rounded modules, cards-inside-cards, neon tech artwork or dark background. Clear screenshot demonstrates THIS INTERACTION: ABOVE = current categories; BELOW = default category's already-present content.
LAYOUT DIRECTION: Category labels are plain text, active 城市治理 uses a precise vivid blue underline and slight boldness. Both category rows are on a white base, neatly aligned. Display six equal scene entries in an airy THREE-COLUMN by TWO-ROW photographic grid below. Each picture is approx390×235 with very subtle corner radius4px, no card background, border or shadow. Beneath photo on same white surface, title20px, explanation14–16px max2 lines, subtle blue 查看详情 →. All entries align in height, wide gutters28–32px, generous vertical gap. This is a modern website's scenic content gallery, not app cards. The six photographs and captions convey capability intuitively. Keep compact hero and complete category area visible above first content row. Focus on excellent typography, photographic realism and restrained technology blue. No icons above images and no large separate feature item.
